About Esima Concept Enterprise

Build Smart! Live Better!

At ESIMA CONCEPT ENTERPRISE, we believe waste management and water should be clean, safe and sustainable. We specialize in the design and installation of Biodigester Systems, Chamberless Clean-Out Systems, Professional Plumbing and Complete Water Treatment Systems.

Unlike conventional septic tanks, our systems are non-polluting, odourless, require no evacuation, and are built to last. Whether it's a single bungalow, a duplex, an estate, or a commercial facility, we deliver efficient solutions tailored to your site and soil condition.

We are committed to quality workmanship, affordable pricing, and excellent after-service support — based in Yenagoa, Bayelsa State and serving clients across Nigeria.

What we offer

Our Services

Four core solutions, engineered for Nigerian soil conditions and built to last.

A. Biodigester System

Modern sewage treatment system that replaces septic tanks. No odour, no evacuation, eco-friendly, saves space and lasts longer.

  • Ideal for all soil types, including waterlogged areas
  • Works across Delta, Bayelsa, Rivers & all of Nigeria
  • No evacuation ever required

B. Chamberless Clean-Out System

Advanced drainage inspection and maintenance system without concrete chambers.

  • Prevents blockages before they start
  • Easier long-term maintenance
  • Neat, unobtrusive finishing

C. Professional Plumbing Services

Complete plumbing for new buildings and maintenance for existing properties.

  • Pipe laying & sanitary fittings
  • Water supply & drainage systems
  • Neat, lasting installation

D. Complete Water Treatment System

We treat borehole water to make it clean, odour-free and safe for domestic and industrial use — handling iron removal, purification, softening and filtration.

  • We also set up sachet & bottle water factories
  • Domestic & industrial capacity
  • Full commissioning & support
